metrics.label: Wall time
metrics.definition: Elapsed monotonic time across the container worker window.
metrics.includes: Runner startup, setup, execution, verification and descendants; not controller staging or cleanup.

metrics.label: Cgroup CPU
metrics.definition: Accumulated CPU time, not elapsed time or electricity.
metrics.includes: All processes and descendants in the container worker window.

metrics.label: Peak memory
metrics.definition: Container lifetime high-water mark, not additive memory consumption.
metrics.includes: Container cgroup lifetime, including descendants and charged page cache; not process RSS.

metrics.label: Block read bytes
metrics.definition: Block-device reads between valid counter endpoints; not logical input-file bytes.
metrics.includes: Block I/O charged to this cgroup during the worker window.

metrics.label: Block write bytes
metrics.definition: Block-device writes between valid counter endpoints; not logical output-file bytes.
metrics.includes: Block I/O charged to this cgroup during the worker window.

metrics.label: CPU throttling
metrics.definition: Observed CPU throttling-time delta; zero is a valid reading.
metrics.includes: Throttling recorded by the cgroup during the worker window.

metrics.label: Wall time
metrics.definition: Elapsed monotonic time across the bounded execution block.
metrics.includes: Selected adapter execution block; engine setup may be included. Not a task-body measurement.

metrics.label: Process CPU
metrics.definition: Runner process CPU time, excluding descendant process CPU.
metrics.includes: Runner process threads within the execution block, not the whole container.

metrics.label: Peak process RSS
metrics.definition: Process lifetime high-water mark; not a peak restricted to the execution interval.
metrics.includes: Dedicated runner process lifetime. The legacy _mb field stores MiB; not additive with cgroup memory.

metrics.label: Modeled energy
metrics.definition: Software-model energy estimate, not a direct electrical measurement.
metrics.includes: Model scope as reported; not inferred from CPU time or elapsed time.

metrics.label: Modeled carbon
metrics.definition: Model-estimated emissions, not measured electricity or a carbon saving.
metrics.includes: Depends on the attached model and carbon-intensity assumptions.
